NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_208: {SAY:missinfo}Skateboarding, as it exists today, was probably born sometime in the late 1940s, or early 1950s,[3][4]
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_209: {SAY:missinfo}when surfers in California wanted something to do when the waves were flat. The first skateboards were made from roller skates attached to a board.[5]
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_21: {SAY:douglas}It’s like something was lost along the way...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_210: {SAY:missinfo}Skateboarding gained in popularity because of surfing: in fact, skateboarding was initially referred to as "sidewalk surfing".[6]
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_211: {SAY:missinfo}The first skateboards were handmade from wooden boxes and planks by individuals. Companies started manufacturing skateboards in 1959, as the sport became more popular.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_212: {SAY:missinfo}But how did these wonderful creations come to be?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_213: {SAY:missinfo}To answer that, we need to go waaaay back.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_214: {SAY:missinfo}The Big Bang is a physical theory that describes how the universe expanded from an initial state of high density and temperature.[1]
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_215: {SAY:missinfo}Various cosmological models based on the Big Bang concept explain a broad range of phenomena,[2][3][4] including the abundance of light elements,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_216: {SAY:missinfo}the cosmic microwave background (CMB) radiation, and large-scale structure.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_217: {SAY:missinfo}The Big Bang Theory is an American television sitcom created by Chuck Lorre and Bill Prady for CBS. It aired from September 24, 2007, to May 16, 2019, running for 12 seasons and 279 episodes.[3]
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_218: {SAY:missinfo}The show originally centered on five characters living in Pasadena, California: Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons),
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_219: {SAY:missinfo}both physicists at Caltech, who share an apartment;
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_222: {SAY:missinfo}waitress and aspiring actress who lives across the hall; and Leonard and Sheldon's similarly geeky and socially awkward friends and coworkers, aerospace engineer Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg)
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_223: {SAY:missinfo}and astrophysicist Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar).[4][5] Over time, supporting characters were promoted to starring roles,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_224: {SAY:missinfo}including neuroscientist Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), microbiologist Bernadette Rostenkowski (Melissa Rauch), and comic book store owner Stuart Bloom (Kevin Sussman).
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_225: {SAY:missinfo}Hopefully you found my neat information tidbits entertaining!

NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_261: {SAY:douglas}First off, they’re literally the worst thing to happen in any game.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_262: {SAY:douglas}Like, how come that I, the better player, lose to peasant RNG?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_263: {SAY:douglas}If you ask me, I’d get rid of them all together.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_264: {SAY:douglas}They’re a detriment to not only the game but humanity itself.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_265: {SAY:douglas}It started off in a goofy shooter game like TF2, but trust me, it’ll end all of us.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_269: {SAY:douglas}We’re all going to be ended by the skilled crit rocket coming our way from a F2P.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_27: {SAY:douglas}That’s how it’s like to be trapped in here.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_270: {SAY:douglas}Like, seriously. Let’s think this through for a second from a critical gameplay perspective.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_271: {SAY:douglas}If I, the player, have a relatively big advantage on a player by counterplay,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_272: {SAY:douglas}Then I, said player, SHOULD win the encounter by having better offense, neutral,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_273: {SAY:douglas}And defensive play. It makes no sense then why the OBJECTIVELY worse PLAYER
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_274: {SAY:douglas}wins the encounter by simply clicking M1. Like, great. Now my day is ruined and
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_275: {SAY:douglas}I’m pooping my pants. TF2, for the most part, has a great sense of balance that has
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_276: {SAY:douglas}been able to keep itself stable over the years. Sure, you got items that break
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_277: {SAY:douglas}the game’s pace much like the Diamondback, Kunai or even sniper himself,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_278: {SAY:douglas}But for the most part, the game’s alright in its balance.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_279: {NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}The Diamondback is a community-created promotional secondary weapon for the Spy.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_280: {SAY:missinfo}It is based on the Diamond Back .357 from the video game Deus Ex: Human Revolution;
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_281: {SAY:missinfo}a futuristic metal Revolver with a black grip, front sight, and cylinder.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_282: {SAY:missinfo}The Diamondback has the ability to store up to 35 Critical hits for later use.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_283: {SAY:missinfo}One Critical hit is stored for each enemy backstabbed, or for each building
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_284: {SAY:missinfo}that is destroyed while being sapped (regardless of whether or not the Sapper is what actually destroys the building).
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_285: {SAY:missinfo}However, any stored Critical hits are lost upon death, and any buildings destroyed with the
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_286: {SAY:missinfo}Spy's Sapper attached while he is dead does not grant any Critical hits.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_287: {SAY:missinfo}In addition, the weapon's base damage is 15% lower than the Revolver,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_288: {SAY:missinfo}and it cannot roll for random Critical hits.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_289: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}The classes for the most part are designed to be able to counter each other
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_291: {SAY:douglas}promote gameplay diversity in classes and team work. You know. The game
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_292: {SAY:douglas}called TEAM FORTRESS 2 requires TEAMWORK. yeah. Crazy. Anyway,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_293: {SAY:douglas}it makes no sense why therefore a PUSHING AND COORDINATED
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_294: {SAY:douglas}TEAM SHOULD DIE to a SINGULAR random critical hit. You’re telling
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_295: {SAY:douglas}me that just because someone got a good roll on the RNG dice
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_296: {SAY:douglas}they get to win OVER ME??? AND MY BETTER AIM AND SKILLS???
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_297: {SAY:douglas}I want you to seriously understand what I’m saying because I'm fed up.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_298: {SAY:douglas}i dont care anymore. This game Is horrible and has been able to still be
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_299: {SAY:douglas}alive thanks to the incompetence of the game’s anti-cheat.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_30: {SAY:douglas}You know, I have to say something else.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_300: {SAY:douglas}Thank god that they decided to publish the SDK code and now everyone
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_301: {SAY:douglas}can do whatever they want and publish it. You know what. Screw this.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_302: {SAY:douglas}I’m going to code the SDK code into having no random critical hits.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_303: {SAY:douglas}It’ll be like TF2. But Better. A better TF2 for all of us.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_304: {SAY:douglas}I’m tired of being bound to the shackles of random critical hits.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_309: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Are you aware of the concept of parallel universes?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_312: {SAY:douglas}But none of them feel like they truly exist.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_313: {SAY:douglas}Some have such radical changes to our status quo...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_314: {SAY:douglas}While for others, you could spend a lifetime not knowing you’re outside of your own.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_315: {SAY:douglas}Even the plants you defend your lawn with have many variants between realities.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_316: {SAY:douglas}So the peashooter has many forms: fire, ice, electric, shoot, even shadow.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_317: {SAY:douglas}But recently there's been new plants that really need to be added to your defence.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_318: {SAY:douglas}So there's three and the first one is Bendy, he shoots wrenches.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_319: {NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}Oh that's sick, but why not ink?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_32: {SAY:douglas}Some higher beings, I don’t know what they are...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_320: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Wait, that's actually a good idea, but look at this Pomni-pult.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_322: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Yeah, zombies would stand no chance, but look at this, it's Wolfy, Hunterria’s wolf.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_324: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}I'm just kidding, actually look at this one.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_326: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Yeah, it's an ender pea, it shoots minecraft blocks.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_328: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}But I personally prefer our own reality.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_329: {SAY:douglas}Even if it has horrendous creatures such as...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_33: {SAY:douglas}They told me to tell you something.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_330: {SAY:douglas}t h e s p o n g e
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_332: {SAY:douglas}I get chills up my spine whenever I think of it.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_333: {SAY:douglas}I remember him meddling with my soul.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_334: {SAY:douglas}But then again... all he wanted was a friend.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_342: {SAY:douglas}And... that’s kind of the only time I ever get to speak with you.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_344: {SAY:douglas}I’m only speaking to you because of a miracle.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_345: {SAY:douglas}I was wondering if he’d prepare another one this year.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_346: {SAY:douglas}Yknow, last year's wasn't all that great.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_348: {SAY:douglas}Spongebob spent all his time trying to craft his best day ever, that he kinda lost his magic along the way.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_349: {SAY:douglas}Me personally? I wouldn't have invited that gorblin fella.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_350: {SAY:douglas}Asking such proposterous riddles. Hate people who waste my time like that.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_351: {SAY:douglas}Like... I just wanna finish the puzzles and get my rewards!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_352: {SAY:douglas}I don’t want this guy speaking to me the entire time!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_355: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Have you heard of the Ancient Egypt theme?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_356: {SAY:douglas}It has these harps at the beginning.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_358: {SAY:douglas}And the wonderful piano melodic lines just spark an itch in my belly.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_359: {SAY:douglas}Did you know that Laura Shigihara, the composer for Plants vs Zombies 1, also composed the Ancient Egypt music theme?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_360: {SAY:douglas}I think it’s better than the Pirate Seas music.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_370: {SAY:douglas}Even the Chinese developers agree with me.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_371: {SAY:douglas}They included it in every world soundtrack for a reason!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_372: {SAY:douglas}Unfortunately they’ve been taken over by more generic instruments.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_373: {SAY:douglas}If I could play an instrument it would be a harp.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_375: {SAY:douglas}I always dreamt of plucking strings that are made out of human tissue.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_379: {SAY:douglas}Just like when you use imppear’s plant food and you hear all of the fart sound effects overlap.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_38: {SAY:douglas}The iconic event that happened years thus far...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_382: {SAY:douglas}I know I´ve been talking for a bit at this point.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_388: {SAY:douglas}I'm sure for some of you, it may bring you back to a more magical moment in life.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_389: {SAY:douglas}For others, you may be thinking of another game.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_390: {SAY:douglas}Like Plants vs. Zombies: Battle for Neighborville.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_392: {SAY:douglas}I asked to appear in that one but my calls were never picked up.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_40: {SAY:douglas}Well... apparently, something was planned this year too.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_400: {SAY:douglas}Could be better. Could be worse, though.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_401: {SAY:douglas}I asked the zombie with the big brain if he was willing to add us to Holiday Mashup.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_402: {SAY:douglas}A very cool world. I like its themes.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_404: {SAY:douglas}I get it. He has his reasons.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_405: {SAY:douglas}But he didn't even want to give our little absorbent friend a chance.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_406: {SAY:douglas}His work would fit in nicely in the chaotic realm of the holidays.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_407: {SAY:douglas}I mean, if zcorp can be there.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_41: {SAY:douglas}Not quite the same type of "event"... but something else.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_412: {SAY:douglas}I´m sure they could make room for us in that schedule.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_413: {SAY:douglas}I wouldn't mind taking over for the levels during the holiday.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_414: {SAY:douglas}Like all the other little guys that have appeared recently.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_419: {SAY:douglas}And yet, we get none of the recognition.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_42: {SAY:douglas}But, in the end, it’s not coming today.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_422: {SAY:douglas}I mean, you campaigned to get costumes into the game.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_424: {SAY:douglas}Maybe we can campaign for us to get a chance.
